seoTitle: How to Edit Your GoDaddy Website Using Built-In AI Tools
metaDescription: Learn how beginners can use GoDaddy's built-in Airo AI to generate and edit website text, layout, and content without any coding experience needed.
intro: GoDaddy's website builder now leans on Airo, its built-in AI, to do the heavy lifting when you set up or update a site — writing copy, picking a layout, and previewing the result before it goes live. This guide is aimed at beginners who want fast, polished edits to a personal blog or small business site without touching code. You'll see how to sign in, let Airo build a page around your domain and business type, and preview the result on mobile before publishing.

steps.heading: Start from the GoDaddy homepage
steps.body: GoDaddy's homepage puts domain search front and center, with a "Grab a .com" panel and a personalized "Pick up where you left off" sidebar for returning users showing shortcuts like an existing site, renewals and billing, and product tips. If you already own a domain and a site, this returning-user panel is the fastest way back into your project instead of navigating the full menu.

image.caption: The GoDaddy homepage for a signed-out visit, with a personalized panel offering quick links back into an existing account.

steps.heading: Sign in to your account
steps.body: Enter your username or customer number and password on the sign-in screen, or use Apple, Facebook, or Google to authenticate instead. Checking "Keep me signed in on this device" saves you from re-entering credentials every session, which is worth doing if you're the one regularly making edits to the site. Once you're in, GoDaddy routes you to your dashboard where your domains and sites live.

image.caption: GoDaddy's sign-in screen, with username and password fields plus Apple, Facebook, and Google sign-in options.

steps.heading: Let Airo build a page from your domain
steps.body: Open your site's editor and GoDaddy's AI, branded Airo, offers to update your Coming Soon page automatically. It reads your domain name and a business category you confirm or edit — in this case "YT PMN Online" paired with a "Tutoring Center" category — and uses that to generate matching page content before you've written a word yourself. Editable fields are underlined so you can correct the business name or category if Airo guessed wrong, then click Publish to have it build the preview.

image.caption: GoDaddy Airo generating a Coming Soon page from a domain name and business category, with a phone preview building on the right.

steps.heading: Review the AI-generated preview
steps.body: Airo renders the finished page inside a phone mockup so you can judge it the way a visitor on mobile actually would — headline, background imagery, and icon set all generated together as a set rather than pieced together manually. In the example here, Airo produced a dark hero section with the headline "Learn Smarter, Achieve More" and a ring of icons matching the tutoring theme it picked up from the business category. This preview step is where you decide whether the AI's first pass is close enough to keep editing or different enough to regenerate.

image.caption: The mobile preview of an Airo-generated Coming Soon page, showing the AI-written headline and themed icon set.

steps.heading: Edit text and sections you want to change
steps.body: Anything Airo generates — headline, subhead, section copy — stays editable the normal way: click into the text and type over it, or ask Airo to rewrite a specific block if you want another AI pass instead of writing it yourself. Treat the AI output as a strong first draft rather than a finished page; swapping in your own voice for the parts that matter most (like the headline and the first paragraph a visitor reads) usually pays off even when the rest of the AI copy stays as-is.

steps.heading: Publish once you're happy with the result
steps.body: When the page reads the way you want, publish it from the same editor you've been working in. Because Airo builds and previews before publishing, you're looking at the actual layout your visitors will see rather than a rough draft — so this is the point to double check business details, contact info, and any placeholder text the AI might have left in a generated section before it goes live.

faq.question: Do I need coding skills to use GoDaddy's AI editing tools?
faq.answer: No, Airo is built into the website builder specifically so beginners can generate and edit pages without touching any code.

faq.question: Can GoDaddy's AI write all my website content for me?
faq.answer: It can generate a full first draft of text, headlines, and layout based on your domain and business type, but most site owners still review and adjust the AI's suggestions to match their voice.

faq.question: Is Airo included in all GoDaddy plans?
faq.answer: Airo's AI features are part of GoDaddy's website builder, so availability depends on which builder plan your site is using.

faq.question: Can I undo changes made with GoDaddy's AI tools?
faq.answer: Yes, you can edit or replace any AI-generated text or section the same way you would edit content manually, and nothing publishes until you click Publish.
